subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Starts Today!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce that our exclusive summer sale starts today! Enjoy up to 50% off on selected items including summer apparel, swimwear, and accessories. This is a limited-time offer, so don't miss out on the chance to upgrade your summer wardrobe at great prices. Visit our store or shop online to explore the amazing deals. Happy shopping! Best regards, The Sales Team
